cases.intended_behavior: Parse pixel requests and escape Lua strings compatibly, including separators and Unicode.
cases.rationale: Covered by Rust protocol compatibility tests and Node-generated protocol fixtures.

cases.intended_behavior: Serialize Inbox and slot replies with optional fields and safe Lua escaping.
cases.rationale: Covered by Rust slot compatibility tests against preserved generated fixtures.

cases.intended_behavior: Decode frames produced by the addon's real Lua pixel encoder.
cases.rationale: Covered by Rust frame compatibility fixtures generated from the addon encoder.

cases.intended_behavior: Run fake adapters and parse bounded stream output without live providers.
cases.rationale: Covered by Rust pipeline tests using the deterministic fixture agent.

cases.intended_behavior: Process a live request through Rust and publish its reply while preserving restart and deduplication rules.
cases.rationale: Covered by live transport integration tests with a fake agent and temporary addon tree.

cases.intended_behavior: Honor the request's per-chat folder as the working directory for the selected agent.
cases.rationale: Covered by a live transport integration test that records the fake agent's working directory and verifies the requested per-chat folder is used.

cases.intended_behavior: Parse SavedVariables outbox requests and deduplicate them with pixel delivery.
cases.rationale: Live SavedVariables and pixel delivery share durable admission even after the bounded recent-ID cache is pruned. Full Windows in-game fallback acceptance remains separate.

cases.intended_behavior: Complete acknowledged chat deletion across restart and every cross-file crash boundary without resurrecting deleted state.
cases.rationale: A process-crash integration test covers all six deletion transaction boundaries, idempotent restart completion, unrelated-chat preservation and stale transport suppression.

cases.intended_behavior: Restore addon chat history into the interface.
cases.rationale: Rust roadmap explicitly defers addon history restoration; pending-reply recovery is a separate contract.

cases.intended_behavior: Apply and publish map commands returned by an agent.
cases.rationale: Slot schema and live map processing are not connected; output cannot yet distinguish feature behavior safely.

cases.intended_behavior: Extract and apply WoW macro commands from agent replies.
cases.rationale: No Rust macro processing seam exists; shared Lua tests do not establish Rust runtime support.

cases.intended_behavior: Extract the last TL;DR block for game chat while retaining the complete reply in the window.
cases.rationale: Slot serialization supports summaries but live response production has no extraction behavior to probe independently.

cases.intended_behavior: Honor in-game allow grants for provider tools.
cases.rationale: Roadmap schedules permission retry as a later parity slice. Future grants must remain restrictive and adapter-validated; no bypass fallback.

cases.intended_behavior: Safely parse SavedVariables outbox fields without executing Lua.
cases.rationale: Bounded Rust parser matches valid Node outbox examples; malformed-input unit tests enforce strict rejection. Live polling and durable admission are tracked by the separate active reload_outbox contract.
